fullDescription: A professional, high-end administrative login system featuring a sophisticated layered background, glassmorphism card components, and a premium color palette of gold, amber, and neutral zinc. Optimized for fintech, enterprise SaaS, or secure data management portals. Design highlights include architectural geometric line patterns, soft gradient blobs for depth, and crisp typography using Satoshi and Cabinet Grotesk. Layout features a centered, high-contrast modal with elegant micro-interactions like scale-on-click and smooth fade-in animations.

structured.summary: Create a secure, enterprise-grade login interface with a 'Modern Executive' aesthetic. Focus on layered visual depth using SVG patterns and soft blurs, while maintaining a clean white-space driven layout for high usability.

style.description: A blend of executive luxury and technical precision. Uses a primary brand gold (#D4AF37) and amber-500 (#F59E0B) for interaction accents. Typography pairs 'Cabinet Grotesk' for bold, authoritative headings with 'Satoshi' for clean, readable body text. Surfaces utilize a 'glass-card' approach with high opacity (0.95) and medium backdrop blurs (12px) to ensure content clarity against a complex background.
style.prompt: Apply a professional aesthetic using a color palette of #D4AF37 (Brand Gold), #F59E0B (Amber-500), #F9FAFB (Background), and #E5E7EB (Border). Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for display titles (font-weight: 700-800) and 'Satoshi' for body/form labels (font-weight: 400-900). Implement a 'glass-card' effect with background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), and a 1px border of #E5E7EB. Shadows should be soft: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(161, 161, 170, 0.2). Animation: Use a standard cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for transitions, and a fade-in-up animation (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y 10px to 0) over 0.6s for the main card container.

layout_and_structure.description: Centered single-column layout optimized for desktop and mobile, with a focus on a vertically stacked central card (460px max-width) and a multi-layered atmospheric background.

prompts.prompt: Create a multi-layered background: 1) Base color #F9FAFB. 2) A grid pattern of 1px circles at 40px intervals (#E5E7EB). 3) An SVG geometric line pattern rotated 30 degrees using #D4AF37 at 3% opacity. 4) Two large decorative blobs (50% size) with a blur of 120px using amber-500/10 gradient in the top-left and bottom-right corners. 5) Two thin architectural accent lines (1.5px width, 256px height) rotated -12 degrees in the margins.

Center the brand logo (height: 64px) above the main card. Below the logo, place a H1 heading using 'Cabinet Grotesk' (size: 30px, weight: 700) followed by a secondary sub-header in 'Satoshi' (size: 14px, weight: 500, uppercase, tracking-widest, color: #71717A).

A 460px wide container with 40px padding. Vertical stack: Label (uppercase, weight: 700, size: 12px, #71717A) -> Input Group (12px rounded, #F9FAFB bg, left-aligned iconify icon, 12px padding) -> Checkbox/Forgot Link row -> Submit Button. Use a 1px border #E5E7EB around the card.

Input fields should have a focus ring: 3px spread of rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1) and border-color: #D4AF37. Submit button: background #F59E0B, rounded-xl (12px), bold text, white color, with a subtle shadow-lg of amber-500/30. Add an 'active:scale-95' micro-interaction on the button.
Inside the card bottom, add a notice box with background #F9FAFB, 1px border #F3F4F6, and 12px padding. Include a small info icon and text at 11px size using Zinc-500 for legal/security disclaimers.

special_ui_components.description: A complex CSS/SVG background stack creating depth without distraction.
special_ui_components.prompt: Combine a radial gradient (amber-500 at 5% opacity) with a custom SVG pattern. The SVG pattern should define a 'geo-lines' pattern (240x240 size) containing a central cross (M 0 120 L 240 120), a diagonal dashed line (stroke-dasharray 10 20), and a center anchor dot. Set the overall rect opacity to 0.03 to keep it professional and subtle.

special_ui_components.description: High-visibility primary action button with security iconography.
special_ui_components.prompt: A heavy-set button with bg-amber-500 (#F59E0B). Height: 54px. Border-radius: 12px. Font: Satoshi Bold. Includes a leading icon (e.g., 'shield-check'). Hover state: background shift to #D97706. Active state: scale down to 0.98. Shadow: custom glow effect using #F59E0B at 30% opacity.
